annotation.authors_or_issuer: Civil Aviation Authority of New Zealand
key_provisions_or_claims: Part 101 aims to maintain a safe operating environment for unmanned aircraft, balloons, kites, rockets, gyrogliders and parasails.
Subpart E covers remotely piloted aircraft, control line and free flight model aircraft.
Amendment 1 dated 22 Dec 2025; NPRM dated 5 April 2025.
Advisory Circular AC101-1 covers RPAS under 25 kg (trial).
Consolidation is for reference, not the official version.
annotation.summary_en: New Zealand Civil Aviation Rules Part 101 consolidation page, setting operating rules for unmanned aircraft including remotely piloted aircraft, balloons, kites, rockets, gyrogliders and parasails. Lists subparts, Amendment 1 (Dec 2025), an NPRM and advisory circular AC101-1 on RPAS under 25 kg. Aims to maintain a safe operating environment.
